items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Oh, I played with them too. I had him played with me too.

ctx.x: Yeah. And now you take, back, 1908. Back, all back up in there. You take McCullen and, they had a tough band. McCullen and, Old Man McCullen. McCullen and Poissy's daddy. Brother Humphrey? Yeah, he's together. Willie Humphrey. Yeah, he's together. See?
Oh, I played with them too. I had him played with me too. The old man, the young man, the two brothers. I played with them all.
Their grandfather was Jim Humphrey, wasn't he? He was a teacher, I think. Yeah, that's the old man.
